extraDisciplines: static-site-only: hand-written HTML/CSS/JS, no bundler, no WASM, no compile step; never propose introducing a build framework.
browser-checks-out-of-annexe: accessibility, Lighthouse and Playwright need the browser sidecar; never invent a browser evaluator, record a HANDOFF (browser) note.
content-is-the-product: copy, messaging and asset integrity outrank code-structure concerns.
estate-health-is-read-not-collected: the snapshot is collected by CI; a night reads it and never re-collects or edits it.
adr-citations-must-exist: cite only ids present in docs/adr/; propose new ADRs by title and leave the id to the operator.
orphan-assets-are-kept: unused diagram images are kept on purpose; no night may propose a prune.
